-- at such an `n`, the strong law is realized up to `ε`.
  calc
  ‖(n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω - μ[X 0]‖
    = ‖(n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (X i ω - Y k i ω) +

      congr

      abel
  _ ≤ ‖(n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (X i ω - Y k i ω)‖ +
        ‖(n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Y k i ω - μ[Y k 0]‖ + ‖μ[Y k 0] - μ[X 0]‖ :=
      norm_add₃_le
